messages:
Sam (sales): Prospect (mid-market payments) wants BYO-KMS/HSM POC. They specifically asked for: perf numbers, cost model for rotation cadence, terraform snippets for the connector, and a short runbook for their infra team. Keep it concise for procurement.
Iris (platform): Important new ask: they want automated KEK rewraps via infra (lambda or k8s cron). That adds occasional bulk unwraps. Latency hit per unwrap depends on RTT; expect 8-30ms extra per call in same-region vs cross-region. We'll quantify in POC.
Noah (crypto): Security notes: provide non-exportability attestation, HSM certs, and optional quorum threshold config (e.g., 2-of-3 custodians) if they need split custody. Quorum ceremonies increase operational overhead and may be scoped as an add-on.
Riley (solutions): For terraform, we can give them a tiny resource example that creates the sidecar config and cert binding. Example snippet to include in POC pack:
```
resource "redwood_kms_connector" "bank" {
  name = "bank-byo-connector"
  endpoint = "https://kms.bank.local"
  auth_method = "mTLS"
  cache_ttl = "300s"
}
```
Sam (sales): They asked how rotation cadence affects cost. Want a simple table (daily/weekly/monthly) with % ops uplift.
Iris (platform): Rule-of-thumb: monthly = baseline; weekly ~+7-12% unwraps; daily ~+40-70% depending on active-key churn and whether we need global rewraps. If they use automated rewraps on role change, add a burst for that event.
Noah (crypto): Recommend options: 1) Ephemeral per-session KEK (strong privacy, higher ops), 2) Long-lived KEK with DEK caching (lower ops). Include revocation and emergency rotation playbook. For quorum, show steps for offline key injection.
Riley (solutions): POC plan: we deliver two sandboxes: A) Redwood-managed envelope (baseline perf), B) BYO-KMS with sidecar + caching. Ask customer to run vegeta or wrk test from their network; sample command we'll include:
```
vegeta attack -duration=60s -rate=50 -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type='hist[95]'
```
Collect p50/p95 and unwrap counts.
infra-bot: ticket created: #SUP-4098 assigned Riley (solutions)  deliverables due 72h.
Sam (sales): Action items: Riley -> terraform snippet + runbook + vegeta targets; Iris -> cost sensitivity table + latency scenarios; Noah -> attestation artifacts + quorum checklist. I'll assemble a 1-page POC summary for procurement.
Iris (platform): Also include fallback policy: if BYO unwrap fails (timeouts), auto-failover to Redwood-managed model variant per route to keep SLAs. Note this has security implications and must be explicit in SOW.
Noah (crypto): Will include a short FAQ for their security questionnaire: key export prevention, audit log retention, rotation windows, and how we prove chain-of-custody during ceremonies.
Sam (sales): Perfect. I'll follow up with the prospect and propose a 2-week POC window once artifacts are ready. :thumbsup:
